book.name: John
book.title: John ka Te Pabe'e Jesus Te Naa Tooa'a-witu Numu oo Tuukwena

content: Saa'a soo Te Pabe'e numme-baasoo tapua petusoo ka banunadu, Tiberius mee naneadu-kumaba'yoona. 'Yoo yise namani.
Numme, Simon Peter, Thomas
Nathanael, e pabe'e James mee naneadu, yise waha'yoo tunakatzimodu, nanano o.
Soo Simon Peter meeoo, “Nu tuukwigakwu.” Numme meeoo, “Numme u-no.” Numme yise sake-wi mea'a, pana togamano gi hemma tzakadu.
Oogow awamooa, unu tu tapuakese, soo Te Pabe'e oona bakumana wunu, pana numme gi oo posopedakwadoo.
Ne wa'agese meeoo, “E pupua'amu, mu haa'a gi tutzakadu?” Numme yise oo nanekwegea, “Gi tuwazoo.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise mee ne netamma, “Ka puma mu tuukwina ka sake tumadinakwatoo tzakweku, mu tuhanehookwu.” Numme yise oo manise, ka tuukwinoo tzamapana, ka ewow pakwe oekoo.
Nu yise ka Peter meeoo netamma, “Masoo tookwa Te Pabe'e.” Soo Peter yise ka gi besa namasooana, wunagow yaahoose, ka baa-witoo nadawunihoose, bakumabatoo bahabehooka.
Numme yise o nageka ka sake-wi, ka tuukwinoo ewow pakwe oekoo oo wupewo'yana.
Numme ka bakumana petuhoogase, numme oo poonne, onoko nabedana pakwe, noko tukaba, o nanohotuku.
Soo Te Pabe'e meeoo ne netamma, “Maka pakwe mu tutzagadu-matu hanehooke.”
Simon Peter yise meahoose ka puma tu tuukwipu bakumabatoo tzabewo'yahoo. Ewa'yoo (153) papabatse'yoo pakwe pana soo puma mu tuukwipu gi natzakebue.
Soo Te Pabe'e meeoo ne netamma, “Mu tukanna.” Numme gi mee oo tubengu, “Haga u?” nnumme ka mooasoo oo sopedakwadoona.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise tukaba noko pakwe ne maka.
Toge pahe (3) soo Te Pabe'e numme tunakatzimodu natzapoonnekute, ka tu ya'e-kwikoo namayodase.

Ka ne tukamakwuse, soo Te Pabe'e ka Simon Peter meeoo netamma, “Simon, u John tooa. U haa'a noko hemma ooonakwasoo besa e soobedya?” Simon mee oo nanekwegea, “Aha, ne Pabe'e, u oo sopedakwatoo nu ume pua'a.” Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo oo netamma, “Umu nu-kwi tunaka'oedyukudu mabetsea.”

Soo Te Pabe'e mee tuwazoo oo tubengasoo, “Simon, u haa'a unu e soobedya?” Soo Simon oo nanekwegeasoo, “Aha, Ne Pabe'e, u oo sopedakwatoo nu ume pua'a.” Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo oo netammasoo, “Ka umu nu-kwi tunaka'oedyukudu mabetsea.”

Sumu tuwazoo soo Te Pabe'e oo tubengasoo, “Simon, u haa'a e pua'a?” Ka Peter suda nenuuma soo Te Pabe'e ka oo tubengasesoo, “U haa'a e pua'a?” Soo Simon meeoo, “U Ne Pabe'e, u no'okosoo hemma sopedakwatoo. U oo sopedakwatoo nu u pua'a.” Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo, “Umu nu-wi tunaka'oedyukudu mabetsea.
Nu togesapa u tuukwekwu, tooebetse'ena u tooe hano tooe mesoo mea u petzabe-kwitoo.
Pana u ka mooatupuyise kukumma'yoosoo numu u mitzakunakwu yise u tayakwu, gi u soomea-kwitoo.”
'Yooonnekoo soo Peter ka Te Naa-koobatoo nabatsakwu, me'esoo Te Pabe'e unnena. Yise meeoo oo netamma, “Nuka nageno.”
Peter wesase e poonne, tu nakwi e me'a
Soo Peter yise ka Te Pabe'e tubengu, “Ne Pabe'e, Ha'oo yise masoo manekwu?”
Soo Te Pabe'e Jesus oo nanekwegea, “Sumuna masoo nummennummekwu e kodyu-kwitootooe esoo gi ume pukwitoo suda soonammena. U sakwa nuka nage-no.”

Ooonne'yoona susumudu tunaka'oedyukudu meeoo, “Soo John gi ya'ekwu.” Esoo gi togesapa. Te Pabe'e meeoo sukwe unakwe, “Sumuna masoo nummennummekwu e kodyu-kwitootooe, esoo gi ume pukwitoo suda soonammena.”
Nu oosoo mu tunakatzimodu-matu oo poonnedu o botugu, ka a namanena. Tamme no'yoona oo sopedakwatoo esoo e tubona kaaheno'yoo a namanena.
Soo Te Pabe'e ewa nanabesa pooha manakwe tuwazoo, nu gi toge besa no'oko mu bo-wa'ne'yoo, umu ewa'yoo. Nu umu-matusoo mu bokute, o'no mu punno'o ka Te Pabe'e-wi tunaka'oedyukukwu.

footnotes.text: Waha-matu; mee tuwazoo nane'a soo Thomas. Soo Nathanael ka Cana mee naneadu-kwitu kemmana ka teepu Galilee mee naneadu-koobatu.
U puu uusoo ka u nate tzakunayakwe.
Nu ka ne yongo tuka ka Te Pabe'e tubengu, “Ne Pabe'e, haga u wahase u nabatsakwu?”
